Fear spread. Nature fought back.

The opening saga begins where cosmic horror, ancient faith, wild ecosystems, and human courage collide.

The First Darkness

In the deepest reaches, Lord Dred forced entire worlds to fear him. With the demon brothers Devoid and Darkvoid, fallen Savior Lunaz, alien warlord Laseriz, and a tide of Dark Minions, his empire reached Earth and vowed to enslave humanity inside a dark void.

Nature created the Saviors of the Universe. Their stars grant evolving powers; their Eco-Devices call warriors, healers, defenders, mages, knights, and even good fiends into battle. Every rescued Lost Soul can begin again as a New Soul.

MALACHIM TRANSMISSION
“Do not be afraid.”
The order arrives before the heavens open and the Summoning Wars begin.

The heavenly orders

The names and traditions become distinct story factions rather than one flattened hierarchy.

Core Three

Michael the protector, Gabriel the messenger, Raphael the healer and guide.

Sevenfold Order

Uriel, Selaphiel, Jegudiel, Barachiel, plus the core three.

Enochian Seven

Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Raguel, Sariel, and Remiel.

Mystic Orders

Metatron, Raziel, Haniel, Zadkiel, Jophiel, Sandalphon, Azrael, and others.

Technical spine

The provided Unreal architecture becomes three production modules with one shared versioned payload.

Save Header

Platform origin, slot, UTC timestamp, game version, and account reference drive deterministic conflict resolution.

FSaveGameHeader

Master Codex Ledger

Species IDs, unlocked-form bitmasks, encounter counts, and capture totals merge across devices.

FEcoKinCodexRecord

Sync Manager

Local binary cache, asynchronous cloud dispatch, version handshake, and max-progress ledger merges.

UCrossPlatformSaveManager
